title: Singapore Rice Noodles
subtitle: with Mushrooms and Capsicum
description: Put down the takeaway menu! This steaming noodle bowl will bring the flavours of Singapore street food to your table quicker than the delivery guy can get on his bike.

steps.text: Prep veggies: Crush or finely chop 1 garlic clove. Cut the spring onion into 3cm lengths, then thinly slice the green part. Peel the carrot, halve lengthwise, then thinly slice. Thinly slice the capsicum, discarding the seeds and membrane. Thickly slice the mushrooms.
Soak noodles: Put the noodles in a large bowl, cover with boiling water and stand for 5 mins or until softened. Drain.

Stir-fry veggies: Meanwhile, heat 1 tbs vegetable oil in a medium deep frypan over medium-high heat. Cook the mushrooms, stirring, for 5 mins or until golden. Remove from the pan. Add 2 tsp vegetable oil, garlic, spring onion, carrot and capsicum to the pan and stir-fry for 3 mins or until just tender. Remove from the pan.

Cook omelette: Whisk 2 eggs and 2 tsp soy sauce in a bowl. Heat 2 tsp vegetable oil in the pan over medium-high heat. Add the egg mixture and cook for 1-2 mins until the base is set, then loosely roll up and transfer to a board. Cool slightly and thinly slice.

Serve up: Heat 2 tsp vegetable oil in the pan over medium heat. Add curry powder and cook for 20 secs or until fragrant. Add noodles and toss well to combine. Add 1 tbs soy sauce and 2 tsp sugar and stir-fry for 1-2 mins until well coated. Add vegetables, season with pepper and toss to combine. Divide the noodles among bowls and top with the omelette strips to serve.
Kitchen hack: For a non-vego version, without adding any prep time, throw in some pieces of ready-roasted chicken.
